technology_name: Evaluation of Traffic Calming Techniques for Safer Roads
institution: KSCSTE - National Transportation Planning and Research Centre (NATPAC)
problem_solved: High vehicle speeds and elevated accident rates at critical road segments such as sharp curves, commercial areas, and school zones.
description: A comprehensive evaluation and regression modeling study analyzing the real-world performance of three common Traffic Calming Measures (TCMs): Speed Humps, Speed Tables, and Transverse Bar Markings (TBMs) across 21 critical locations in Kerala. Free-flow speed data extracted via drone videography and spatial tracking software (Kinovea and Data from Sky) was paired with 3-year pre- and post-implementation crash data. Multiple linear regression models prove that structural height increases speed reduction, whereas structural width decreases its efficacy.
applications:
• Urban planning and municipal civil engineering layout designs

• National and state highway speed-management regulation updates

• Public works safety audits for school zones and dense residential centers

• Smart city traffic engineering guidelines and infrastructure deployment
secondary_sector: Digital Technologies, AI & Software, Robotics, Automation & Drones
